def: The probability that an experiment detects an effect of a given size when that effect is real; it depends on sample size, effect size, variance and significance level.
practice: Aim for about 80% before running an eval comparison or A/B test; Card et al. (2020) found many NLP comparisons underpowered, with typical 2,000-sentence translation test sets at about 75% power for a 1 BLEU difference.
